description: M1.2 schema cases. Each file is loaded and validated; its findings must equal exactly the list given, which is how the tests prove a dedicated rule is not also reported as R09. A location is marker text: the expected line and column are those of the marker's first character (or of its n-th occurrence) in the file, found independently of the parser. The three base manifests are the positive case for every constraint they exercise.
